details:
I heard Rumors that you lose a lot of your venture capital.

So i propose to you a change; to not relay on venture capitalism only.

In fact my ideas are simple: 

1. Use the loading screen of VRChat,per loading, as a advertisement board. 

Putting Image ads onto it or even making the loading 3D space into a themed image ads.

2. World Creator affiliation program. A creator can participate in this program; if his world is popular, in constant, by a yearly statistic. He can sign into the program and place the advertisement poster onto the wall. For every advertisement poster; the World Creator get 20% per month. Once a Month you can send a inspection bot with would snap a whole world picture to proof that the ads are there. 

3. Voluntary Server Charity 

Create a proprietary server hosting tool for the community.

Of course with security features like 'Kerebos' cryptography.

Client side authentication check.

Hosting Tool script check; if there was no tinkering with the hosting tool.

Make peoples aware that server cost money and that it ain't easy for VRChat to keep the investors funding running consistently. Ask them to help out by hosting own server on their machine. Give them special features like: 

A.Can make World +18. (Not instance based)

B.Allows to configure Content Delivery Network (CDN)  support for faster download.

C. Chart Booster: It will be shown and promoted on top from any other World, with themed banner overlay, as Nr.1

World in the newest Worlds. However, VRChat can use this as advantage point. As more people might use it. They can pay small fees to stay up in the chart. Otherwise, the next world creator just overtakes his place. While the one who was Nr.1. Even with a new World can't get this boost again. 

C.C Their Worlds also will appear in Home Worlds of Players, as marked portal with sign of Nr.1. The Portal will be golden instead of blue. 

D. Hoster can set his own Player Limit. So instead of 80 it can be more like 100-300. 

F. Avatars with very poor or poor can be blocked from joining. 

G. Hoster get a administrative Menu with allows him to ban user, invite user, list user, restrict user Integration [Voice, Chat,Block user from seeing other User, Avatar ban]  in instance/world overlook. Even give him the ability to get a  overlook list of users from another instances/worlds and allow them to send one packages [Message] of invitations. [This might give them a big advantage and even bring People into self hosting servers]

G.G Automatically invitations towards other world instances. Even if hoster is non active.
title: Proposing VRChat Economical Model
